neighbours.label: the first word of an object relative clause: French relative 'que/qu'' and English zero-relative clauses ('a man the town respected')
fire: Voici la maison que mon grand-père a construite en 1950.
Elle a perdu la bague qu'il lui avait offerte.
C'est le livre que tous les élèves doivent lire.
Nous avons visité le village que ma mère aimait tant.
She was a singer the whole country adored.
This is the road the soldiers marched along in 1944.
He finally sold the boat his father had built.
It was a decision the committee would regret for years.
quiet: Mon grand-père dit que la maison a été construite en 1950.
Elle savait qu'il était parti avant midi.
Ce livre est plus long que celui de l'année dernière.
Nous espérons que le village restera calme.
She was a singer who toured the whole country.
The soldiers marched along this road in 1944.
He finally sold the boat to his neighbour.
The committee made a decision on Tuesday.

predictions: relative que/qu' after a noun and English contact clauses fire on their first word; conjunction/comparative que and subject relatives stay quiet
